name: DiamondClicks
description: Hold = autoclicker. While you hold, every frame is a real click instead of a plain held jump.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the autoclick-on-hold behaviour on or off. When off, holding works like in vanilla.

click-delay.name: Click delay (frames)
click-delay.description: Frames between clicks while you hold. <cy>1</c> = a fresh click on every frame (release + press). <cy>2+</c> = a 1-frame tap every N frames.
